title: Research at Microsoft 2023: A year of groundbreaking AI advances and discoveries
description: AI saw unparalleled growth in 2023, reaching millions daily. This progress owes much to the extensive work of Microsoft researchers and collaborators. In this review, learn about the advances in 2023, which set the stage for further progress in 2024. The post Research at Microsoft 2023: A year of groundbreaking AI advances and discoveries appeared first on Microsoft Research .
